create_callback_class: create a custom Callback subclass that implements on_batch_collected to process sampling batches
create_callback_on_train_step: create a Callback subclass with on_train_step that computes a custom loss and returns a TensorDict
create_callback_on_evaluation_end: create a Callback subclass with on_evaluation_end to process evaluation rollouts after each eval
create_partial_callback: create a Callback subclass that implements only on_setup without requiring all lifecycle methods
run_experiment_with_callbacks: run a BenchMARL Experiment with a list of custom Callback instances attached to it
